# Third-party licences

<!-- Generated by `make license_check WRITE=1`. Edit tools/licenses.json instead. -->

The JerryProxy source in this repository is Apache-2.0. Everything below is a third-party component that reaches a user through the wheel's dependency chain or is embedded in a standalone executable.

## Conveyed Python distributions

`wheel` means the component is reached through the published wheel's
dependency chain. `standalone` means it is embedded in the PyInstaller
executables, where there is no dependency resolution to defer to.

| Component | Licence | Reaches | Obligation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| certifi | MPL-2.0 | wheel, standalone | weak-copyleft |
| charset-normalizer | MIT | wheel, standalone | notice |
| click | BSD-3-Clause | wheel, standalone | notice |
| colorama | BSD-3-Clause | wheel, standalone | notice |
| filelock | Unlicense or MIT | wheel, standalone | none |
| idna | BSD-3-Clause | wheel, standalone | notice |
| importlib-metadata | Apache-2.0 | wheel, standalone | notice |
| inquirerpy | MIT | wheel, standalone | notice |
| markdown-it-py | MIT | wheel, standalone | notice |
| mdurl | MIT | wheel, standalone | notice |
| pfzy | MIT | wheel, standalone | notice |
| prompt-toolkit | BSD-3-Clause | wheel, standalone | notice |
| pygments | BSD-2-Clause | wheel, standalone | notice |
| pyinstaller | GPL-2.0-or-later WITH Bootloader-exception | standalone | bootloader-exception |
| pyinstaller-hooks-contrib | Apache-2.0 AND GPL-2.0-or-later WITH Bootloader-exception | standalone | bootloader-exception |
| pysocks | BSD-3-Clause | wheel, standalone | notice |
| requests | Apache-2.0 | wheel, standalone | notice |
| rich | MIT | wheel, standalone | notice |
| tabulate | MIT | wheel, standalone | notice |
| tqdm | MPL-2.0 AND MIT | wheel, standalone | weak-copyleft |
| typing-extensions | PSF-2.0 | wheel, standalone | notice |
| urllib3 | MIT | wheel, standalone | notice |
| wcwidth | MIT | wheel, standalone | notice |
| zipp | MIT | wheel, standalone | notice |

### Notes

- **certifi** — Root certificate bundle reached through requests. Shipped unmodified; MPL-2.0 section 3.2 is satisfied by naming the upstream release as the source form.
- **colorama** — Windows-only dependency of click; present in the Windows standalone executable.
- **filelock** — Upstream relicensed between 3.19.1 and 3.30.0. JerryProxy pins a different filelock line per interpreter, so both licences are conveyed depending on the Python version; both are permissive and impose no source obligation.
- **importlib-metadata** — Reached only on Python versions without a sufficient standard-library implementation.
- **pyinstaller** — Build-time only, except for the bootloader that is linked into every frozen executable. PyInstaller's licence grants an explicit exception permitting the resulting executable to be distributed under terms of the author's choosing. JerryProxy relies on that exception; without it the standalone artifacts could not be Apache-2.0. The exception does not extend to a modified bootloader, so the bootloader must stay unmodified.
- **pyinstaller-hooks-contrib** — Build-time only, except for runtime hooks that PyInstaller embeds in the frozen executable. Distributed under the same dual arrangement as PyInstaller itself, so the same bootloader exception governs the result.
- **tqdm** — Shipped unmodified; MPL-2.0 section 3.2 is satisfied by naming the upstream release as the source form.
- **typing-extensions** — Reached only on Python versions that need the backported typing constructs.
- **zipp** — Reached through importlib-metadata.

## Backend binaries

Backend binaries are never bundled. They are downloaded from their official upstream release after installation and executed as independent programs, so they are not combined with JerryProxy into one work and their terms do not reach the wheel or the standalone executables. Their licences are recorded because a user distributing a populated JerryProxy home does convey them.

| Backend | Upstream | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| mihomo | MetaCubeX/mihomo | MIT |
| sing-box | SagerNet/sing-box | GPL-3.0-or-later WITH a naming restriction |
| xray | XTLS/Xray-core | MPL-2.0 |
| v2ray | v2fly/v2ray-core | MIT |

### Notes

- **sing-box** — The added clause is why GitHub cannot classify it. JerryProxy neither derives from nor renames sing-box, so the clause is satisfied by leaving the upstream binary and its name intact.
